claims.text: Move-by-move reconstruction traces are not self-interpreting behavioral evidence: conclusions depend materially on the observation operator used to map notation and cube states into candidate phenomena.
claims.independence_note: Serial methodological lineage, not independent replications; strength comes from falsification succession and out-of-development transport, not artifact count.
claims.wording_guard: Do not turn this into a universal theorem about all behavioral traces.

claims.text: Within this reconstruction corpus, algebraic/state-equivalent local shortening is not a defensible standalone operationalization of cognitive recovery or error.
claims.wording_guard: Do not claim humans never make locally redundant recovery moves.

claims.text: Temporary movement away from an exact phase endpoint in full cube-state distance is common under ordinary algorithm execution and is not a defensible standalone recovery marker.
claims.wording_guard: Do not say phase reversals never carry cognitive information in richer designs.

claims.text: Phase-specific quotient geometry and directly attempt-level familywise calibration provide a more stable engineering basis than exact full-state endpoint distance and segment-tail any-exceedance aggregation.
claims.wording_guard: More stable does not mean cognitively valid or universally optimal.

claims.text: Observation-operator transport can be solving-method specific: CFOP/ZB transport passed under the frozen LAYERED court while Roux required a separate block/gauge ontology.
claims.wording_guard: Do not infer population method differences in cognition.

claims.text: For the studied Roux reconstruction representation, a prefix-identifiable route coordinate gauge is better supported than per-state center canonicalization as the frame for preserving block identity.
key_evidence: per-state center gauge changed FB->SB on ~96.9% in R1.12 development
claims.wording_guard: Do not describe the gauge as a latent mental coordinate frame.

claims.text: The frozen G4 state ontology transported from development data to a baseline-present but development-unseen Roux route set under a frozen canonical reference scorer.
claims.wording_guard: Preexisting unseen is not post-freeze fresh and cannot release future authority.

claims.text: Genuinely post-freeze Roux authority has not yet been tested because the frozen R1.14 watch observed zero post-freeze raw Roux routes.
claims.wording_guard: Do not reinterpret data wait as measurement failure or success.

claims.text: Cognitive recovery/error prevalence can be estimated from the current CUBE-REV reconstruction courts.
blocking_debt: annotation/state categories are observable rather than mental-state labels
claims.closure_test: Would require a separately designed human/behavioral validation program and fresh measurement authority; current synthetic/public trace analysis cannot substitute.

claims.text: CUBE-REV is the first work to study observation-operator validity in speedcubing reconstruction traces.
claims.supporting_context: Targeted search found Rubik's Cube skill acquisition, expertise, macro-operator/decomposition, collective intelligence, tutoring and performance work, but no direct analogue was identified in the limited search.
claims.closure_test: Systematic literature search with explicit databases/query families, backward/forward citation chasing, and a novelty comparison table.

manuscript_rule: No prose claim may exceed its ledger authority. PROHIBITED/HOLD claims may appear only as limitations, debts, or hypotheses.

family_ablation.interpretation: The central thesis should remain coherent if one artifact within a family is removed; it may legitimately narrow if an entire provenance family is ablated.
